birth.stop: Worcester, the hour written into a horoscope
birth.date_confidence: reconstruction. No parish register survives. The date and the hour of four in the afternoon are known only because John Dee, thirty years later, wants a nativity to cast and writes down what the man across his table tells him. Some writers give London as the birthplace instead; the DNB disputes Worcester and the record does not resolve it.

stops.stop: Most, the death and the dates that do not agree
stops.date_confidence: open conflict, not adjudicated. Czech Wikipedia gives 1 November 1597, aged 42. English accounts give late 1597 or early 1598. The Dictionary of National Biography gives three dates and all three fall in 1595: Ashmole 5 February, Anthony Wood October, and Dee's own diary 25 November. Two full years separate the English record from the Czech one. This file uses the Czech date as its spine and does not claim it settles anything.
